title.html: What if everyone on Earth couldn't stop dancing?

subs: Tuesday. 2:14 PM. The library.
Every human on Earth starts dancing.
Nobody can stop.
+1 minute. A surgeon, mid-operation.
Even the patient keeps the beat.
+10 minutes. 35,000 feet.
Seatbelts stay on. Arms go up.
+1 hour. Grocery shopping is a conga line now.
Every kick clears a shelf.
+2 hours. The President addresses the nation.
The nation does the robot back.
+6 hours. A funeral.
The pallbearers were born for this.
+1 day. Gary hasn't finished a meal since Tuesday.
Every spoonful takes eleven tries.
+1 week. 70,000 people. One beat.
The ground registers an earthquake.
+1 month. Job interviews are dance-offs now.
Gary has never been more hireable.
+1 year. The fittest year in human history.
Gyms go out of business.
Turns out, everybody wanted to dance.
They were just waiting for someone else to start.
Nobody has tried to stop since.

GHANA'S DANCING PALLBEARERS · A REAL JOB

end.html: What song would you be stuck dancing to?
